entities.title: No conformance profile claimed
entities.summary: The library claims none of the spec's conformance profiles yet; it implements the everyday subset of library-api 0.3.
entities.impact: Code that needs a whole profile (core-civil, zoned, …) cannot rely on this library for it.

entities.title: No rules shipped
entities.summary: The library ships no zone rules, leap-second table or calendars. Zone rules are always loaded by the caller, and there is no default context.
entities.impact: A caller must find, version and load rule data itself; resolving without it is impossible by design.

entities.title: Structural validation is partial
entities.summary: Utv.validateStructural checks the envelope, the version, the 26 kinds and their required and allowed properties, interval constructions and series samples. Nested value types, enums, $ref sub-schemas and oneOf alternatives are not fully enforced.
entities.impact: Some values the schema rejects pass this validator as valid.

entities.title: Only the everyday subset
entities.summary: Everything outside the everyday API (conversion between domains, recurrence expansion, other kinds and calendars) is unsupported. Typed values exist only for civil date, year-month, time and date-time, instants, calendar, POSIX and SI amounts, and start-end intervals of dates or instants.
entities.impact: Other UTV values can be validated and held as JSON, but not computed with.

entities.title: Proleptic Gregorian only
entities.summary: Civil values in any other calendar or chronology are unsupported (unsupported-calendar in operations, utv.unsupported from GregorianCivil.validate).
entities.impact: A Hebrew or Hijrah date cannot be checked or computed with.

entities.title: POSIX timescale only
entities.summary: Instants must be on the unix-posix timescale, without coordinate or quality; anything else is unsupported (unsupported-operand).
entities.impact: TAI, GPS or UTC instants with leap seconds cannot be used.

entities.title: No leap seconds
entities.summary: Second 60 is unsupported (leap-second) everywhere but structural and Gregorian validation, and adding SI seconds to an instant is unsupported (needs-leap-seconds).
entities.impact: 23:59:60 can be stored as JSON but not used; ElapsedSeconds cannot move an Instant.

entities.title: ISO 8601 extended forms only
entities.summary: Week dates, ordinal dates and the basic format are unsupported (unsupported-form); 24:00 is unsupported (end-of-day); annotations other than one [Area/Location], and a [zone] after Z or -00:00, are unsupported (unsupported-annotation); EDTF qualifiers and decimal period components are unsupported (unsupported-form).
entities.impact: Such text has to be converted before it reaches the library.

entities.title: Some values have no text form
entities.summary: Mixed-sign periods, exact second counts, offsets with seconds, start-amount intervals and every other kind have no text form (no-text-form). Their toString() is JSON or, for second counts, a display string that cannot be parsed.
entities.impact: Such values round-trip only as JSON.

entities.title: Never beyond the rules' window
entities.summary: Zone operations answer unsupported (outside-rule-window) outside a bundle's validFrom..validUntil; resolve also needs a day's margin on each side of the wall time. Zones missing from the bundle are unsupported (unknown-zone).
entities.impact: With the demo rules, only 2026 and 2027 in New York, Paris and Reykjavik resolve.

entities.title: A few 64-bit edges
entities.summary: Years and instants are arbitrary precision, but Period components are longs (beyond them fromJson is unsupported, implementation-limit), Instant.unixSeconds() throws ArithmeticException beyond a long, Instant.atOffset throws ArithmeticException and Instant.inZone answers unsupported (implementation-limit) for a fraction finer than a nanosecond.
entities.impact: Extreme values must stay in the JSON layer.

entities.title: Intervals of dates or instants
entities.summary: contains and overlaps handle start-end intervals of civil/gregory dates or physical instants only; mixing domains or zones is unsupported.
entities.impact: Date-time or start-amount ranges cannot be tested.

entities.title: java.time's range
entities.summary: Converting back to java.time is unsupported (out-of-native-range) beyond LocalDate's years (±999,999,999), Period's int components or Duration's range.
entities.impact: Values beyond those ranges stay UTV values.
